body:
Age: 21

Hello, My name is MalaNala!(or you can call me Kizzy) I am 21 ^ as you saw.. I would like to apply to staff because I enjoy helping the community blossom!!
I sadly have a job Tues and Thurs otherwise I am free Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun less something comes up, so I can not promise a full on hardcore staff shift if I ever become part, but I can try my best! I can help this community with positivity! <3

Thank you!

Timezone: America Chicago(central time)

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:  Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes | KfizzyLHpop

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

heads up Note: I have anxiety and am very self concious about my voice because it is high pitched please do not be alarmed
